    45	## Usage
    46	
    47	fzf is an interactive Unix filter program. It reads a list of items from
    48	standard input, allows you to select a subset of the items, and prints the
    49	selected ones to standard output.
    50	
    51	### Basic Usage
    52	
    53	```sh
    54	# Find files
    55	find * -type f | fzf
    56	
    57	# Find processes
    58	ps aux | fzf
    59	
    60	# Find command history
    61	history | fzf
    62	```
    63	
    64	### Display Modes
    65	
    66	#### --height mode
    67	
    68	Use `--height` option to limit the height of the finder:
    69	
    70	```sh
    71	fzf --height 40%
    72	```
    73

    75	
    76	fzf can be displayed in a tmux popup window:
    77	
    78	```sh
    79	fzf --tmux
    80	```

    82	### Search Syntax
    83	
    84	Unless specified otherwise, fzf starts in "extended-search mode" where you can
    85	type in multiple search terms delimited by spaces.
    86	
    87	| Token     | Match type                 | Description                          |
    88	| --------- | -------------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
    89	| `sbtrkt`  | fuzzy-match                | Items that match `sbtrkt`            |
    90	| `'wild`   | exact-match (quoted)       | Items that include `wild`            |
    91	| `^music`  | prefix-exact-match         | Items that start with `music`        |
    92	| `.mp3$`   | suffix-exact-match         | Items that end with `.mp3`           |
    93	| `!fire`   | inverse-exact-match        | Items that do not include `fire`     |
    94	| `!^music` | inverse-prefix-exact-match | Items that do not start with `music` |
